story.zh:
董卓

挟天子后在朝中横行霸道，逃出洛阳的曹操欲发布号令召集天下英雄联合讨贼。

洛阳、长安属董卓，陈留属曹操，长沙属孙坚，襄阳属刘表，袁绍、公孙瓒、韩馥为君主。
story.en:
Dong Zhuo

runs rampant at court after holding the emperor hostage. Having fled Luoyang, Cao Cao seeks to issue a call to arms, rallying the realm's heroes to unite and punish the traitor.

Luoyang and Changan belong to Dong Zhuo, Chenliu belongs to Cao Cao, Changsha belongs to Sun Jian, and Xiangyang belongs to Liu Biao. Yuan Shao, Gongsun Zan, and Han Fu are Rulers.

trigger.zh: 曹操、袁绍、袁术、孙坚、公孙瓒、韩馥、张杨、刘表等诸侯存活。刘关张三人存活。
trigger.en: Warlords such as Cao Cao, Yuan Shao, Yuan Shu, Sun Jian, Gongsun Zan, Han Fu, Zhang Yang, and Liu Biao are alive. Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei are alive.
